$comment: F-5.2 approved publication state for scripts/security/verify-publication-governance.mjs.
This file is a RULING, not a measurement. It records the catalogue state the
owner has approved. The verifier compares production against it and reports
any difference — so when the owner legitimately publishes a new course, the
verifier is SUPPOSED to go red until this file is updated to match. That is
the control working: a publication that nobody wrote down is exactly what
F-5.2 exists to surface.
WHY THIS NOW ENCODES 8 COURSES (CAT-ARCH-03, R4b + R4c).
The eighth course, `donnez-envie-a-vos-clients-de-revenir`, has been
published since before the 2026-09-06 ruling but carried no academic code,
so it appeared in no catalogue and was deliberately left out of the approved
state pending an owner decision (R4b). It was the single failing check on
this verifier for three weeks.
On 2026-09-27 at 22:06:34Z the owner assigned it C1-F4 through the Admin
form — the CAT-1 assignment path, after migration 057 had registered C1-F4
at Fondations position 1. That assignment is IRREVERSIBLE: migration 028's
`courses_code_immutable` trigger permits NULL -> code exactly once. The
course therefore now opens the Fondations catalogue, which is what V8
requires, and the public projection carries 8 courses instead of 7.
Bara ratified that state on 2026-09-27 and approved this file being brought
into line with it. Nothing in the database was changed to produce this
update: the numbers below were read from production, GET-only.
TWO CORRECTIONS CARRIED AT THE SAME TIME, both long-standing:
* `developper-une-culture-client` has carried C2-F5 in production for
weeks while this file still said `code: null`. The verifier keys on slug,
so it never caught the drift.
* C1-F1 and C2-F1 each grew from 17 to 18 lessons through ordinary owner
authoring, previously reported as growth notices.
PREVIEW FLAGS ARE NOT A COMMERCIAL RULING.
`preview_lessons` is observational and informational only, per the
2026-09-06 ruling — the verifier reports it and never fails on it. C1-F4 is
recorded below with 8 of 8 lessons flagged `is_preview`, which means the
whole course is currently readable by an anonymous visitor and it is the
first card in Fondations. Recording that number is NOT an approval that it
must stay that way: the owner has explicitly reserved the free/paid split on
C1-F4 as a separate content and commercial decision to review with Marième.
CAT-ARCH-03 changed no preview flag.
TO UPDATE: change `approved_state`, bump `approved_at`, and say who ruled.
Updating this file is the act of approving what production already shows —
do it deliberately, not to make a red verifier go green.
ruling: The production catalogue of 8 published, coded courses is approved. `donnez-envie-a-vos-clients-de-revenir` is approved as C1-F4 and as the first formation in Fondations; its assignment on 2026-09-27 at 22:06:34Z is ratified as intentional and authorised, and R4b is closed. Supersedes the 2026-09-06 ruling, which approved 7 courses while the eighth was uncoded. Migration 049's 5-published/2-withdrawn state remains superseded and must NOT be restored. Preview flags remain owner-managed content configuration and are NOT ruled on here: the free/paid split of C1-F4 is reserved for separate review with Marième.

strictness.is_published: EXACT — any difference is reported as drift and must be explained or approved.
strictness.course_set: EXACT — a course appearing or disappearing is drift.
strictness.lessons: GROWTH ALLOWED — the owner authors content continuously. Growth is reported as informational; SHRINKAGE is reported as drift, because lessons should not vanish.
strictness.preview_lessons: INFORMATIONAL — owner-managed content configuration per the 2026-09-06 ruling, reaffirmed 2026-09-27. Reported, never failed, and never an approval of the free/paid split.
